changelog: Fixed Bulk Transfer Target Record date mismatches by applying the app's local date and confirming it before Save, even when NetSuite automatically supplies a different date.
Bulk Transfer can reapply changed guardrails to the full reviewed batch after mixed results, including records previously marked Completed, Failed, or Skipped - Manual Review.
Improved Target Record updates during Bulk Transfer by retrying a native checkbox action once when NetSuite does not accept it on the first attempt.
Merge now shows an unavailable Subcustomer count as Unknown instead of 0, and highlights records with a confirmed positive Subcustomer count.
Improved the navigation header so long account details fade before the Help controls while the NS Flow brand remains visible.
Refined theme behavior for Merge, ROE, and SuiteWorld action buttons, including disabled states.
